note: 目标 encaustic-painting 全正文全部FAQ核读。原句：Encaustic painting's origin is uncertain by its own earliest chronicler: writing around 77 AD, Pliny the Elder stated flatly that \"it is not agreed who was the inventor of painting in wax,\" recording several competing claims before crediting Pausias of Sicyon as the first artist to become famous at it. The \"Punic wax\" recipe long cited as the medium behind the Fayum mummy portraits fares no better under modern testing: a 2020 study published by Getty, focused on two Art Institute of Chicago portraits, reviewed recipes recorded from Otto Donner von Richter in 1893 through Euphrosyne Doxiadis in the 1990s, and repeated as settled fact in reference works including The Oxford History of Western Art, and reported that scientific analysis had not established those specific combinations in mummy portraits. Identifying beeswax does not establish how it was prepared. The same study found beeswax as the major binder in both paintings, including one that looks nothing like encaustic, undercutting the visual test art historians have used for over a century to sort portraits into \"encaustic\" and \"tempera\" groups.。源当前句：A similar gap between an assumed technique and what the documented record actually supports shows up in [the proposed Punic-wax formulas for Fayum portraits, whose preparation cannot be established simply by identifying beeswax](/encaustic-painting/).。本批全读原及改稿5FAQ，Getty2020完整相关主文证实分析出beeswax并不定制备recipe。原never found概括过强，改为recipe preparation无法仅由binder识别；两knownglazes与ancient uncertainty明确分开。
